findings.finding: The advertised downloaded-release verifier imported repository modules and therefore could not be trusted to work from the delivery alone.
findings.repair: Ship a deterministic single-file Python zipapp using only the standard library and Git; invoke it from an unrelated working directory with PYTHONPATH cleared.
validation: zipapp contains exactly __main__.py
no DriftProof package installation or source checkout is required
success and failure each emit exactly one JSON object
invalid deliveries return exit 30

findings.finding: A recipient had no obvious verifier at the release root and no copy-paste command in the human, browser, machine, or judge entry points.
findings.repair: Publish verify-release.pyz at the release root, document `python verify-release.pyz .`, and expose the argument vector in generated submission metadata and the judge checklist.
validation: release manifest and SHA256SUMS include verify-release.pyz
START_HERE Markdown and HTML describe the command
submission manifest exposes downloaded_release_verify
judge checklist describes exit-30 fail-closed behavior

findings.finding: The verifier binary could have been replaced and rehashed without proving that it was built from the verifier source in the Git-backed release commit.
findings.repair: Bind zipapp bytes, member bytes, member CRC, source path, and source SHA-256 in the release manifest; compare the source hash with both source and full archives before accepting the delivery.
validation: zipapp member SHA equals the declared source SHA
source/full archives contain the same verifier source bytes
full archive repository.bundle binds the release main commit
modified verifier plus updated manifest and checksum is rejected

findings.finding: An outer checksum validates bytes but cannot by itself preserve semantic relationships among the trajectory packet, trace index, claim ledger, rubric, submission manifest, verifier source, archives, and Git bundle.
findings.repair: After checksum validation, independently cross-verify all inner identities and archive/root copies before returning verified=true.
validation: rehashed trajectory substitution is rejected
rehashed verifier substitution is rejected
all eight delivery entry points are byte-identical across root and archives
rubric remains bound to the exact claim ledger and totals 100 points

findings.finding: A standalone recipient needed the same archive traversal, special-file, size, duplicate-name, encryption, member-count, CRC, delivery, evidence, and Git-bundle checks as the source verifier.
findings.repair: Reimplement the complete bounded archive and embedded-bundle verification contract inside the zipapp rather than weakening the downloaded path.
validation: all three archives are fully read and CRC-verified
unsafe archive names and special modes fail closed
evidence archive must contain every qualified review
embedded Git bundle must list the manifest commit as refs/heads/main
